Period of work :- 08 (Eight) months The Pre-qualification criteria (PQC)to qualify in Techno commercial Part are as below:- st 1. Average Annual financial turnover during the last 3 years, ending 31 March of the previous financial year should be at least 30% of the estimated cost i.e.R s 46.22 Lakhs. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant/ Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details and containing Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) in it for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid . Turnover details submitted without UDIN shall be summarily rejected. 2. Experience of having successfully completed “Similar works” at any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU / Public Listed Company during last 07 years ending last day of month previous to the one in which application are invited should be either of the following: a) Three Similar completed each works consisting not less than4 0% of estimated Cost or the amount equal to Rs6 1.63 Lakhs or b) Two Similar completed each works consisting not less than5 0% of estimated Cost or the amount equal to Rs 77.04 Lakhs or c) One Similar completed work consisting not less than8 0% of estimated Cost or the amount equal to Rs.1 23.27 Lakhs. 3.Similar works means : Civil Construction work / Civil Maintenance work / Cleaning and sweeping work/ Sanitation work / Painting work . 4. Tenderer must upload relevant work Order & Completion Certificate against each work. 5. Bidders must attach Work done certificate mentioned executed amount and date of completion 6. Necessary documentary evidences in support of the same in the form of copy of Work Orders & Completion Certificates from the competent authority of client, along with the contact details of the signatories shall be furnished, in absence of which the offer will be rejected. Any other document / certified drawing as desired by UCIL, to assess the Similar Work shall have to submitted. 7. Public Sector Undertakings, State Government Undertakings, may be exempted from payment of EMD with the approval of Competent Authority. MSME/Small Scale Industries (SSI) with current valid registration with State or Central Govt. shall be exempted from payment of EMD (after ensuring that the registration in case of SSI) pertains to the class of items/stores/works for which the tender is floated) by the authority competent to conclude supply/ contract orders.

The tender documents shall be issued free of cost to company/units registered with MSME/National Small Indust ries Corporation/Director of Industries of State, Cottage Industries approved by the State Authority or any other entity as may be specified by Govt. guidelines from time to time, after ensuring that the approval pertains to th e class of item/works for which tender is floated. Benefit for MSME owned by SC/ST will be applicable as per the Govt. guide lines. In case of Government undertaking / PSU, tender documents may be issued free of cost subject to approval of C ompetent Authority and it shall be mentioned in the tender document.
